notes.title: Kickstarter Prelaunch
notes.notes:
Exciting News! Our Kickstarter Pre-launch! 🎉🌿

Spirit of Meda's Kickstarter campaign will launch on November 7th, 2023!

A huge thank you to all of you who have supported us thus far and for staying by our side as we bring this game to life!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/broadleafdigital/spirit-of-meda]Kickstarter Prelaunch[/url]

Please be sure to share this with all of your friends and loved ones!
Thank you to all of you for you support and holding out with us! 🎉🌿

Yours Truly,
Broadleaf Digital
